principles: A current assignment, catalog name, Wiki category facet, recipe-title edge, or quest parameter alone is not semantic proof.
Read the exact pinned item page and exact infobox variant for each numeric ID. Never transfer a decision between IDs by name or family.
Quest association establishes a quest role, not that the item has no independent use. Preserve independently documented equipment, access, transport, tool, ingredient, resource, and container roles.

Category, subcategory, and Ironman tab are evaluated separately. TOOL routes to skilling-tools; CLEANUP routes to storage-cleanup. The subcategory then selects a BankTags destination when a category split exists.
A negative conclusion such as junk, obsolete, quest-only, or no longer useful requires direct affirmative source wording. Missing facts and absent fields remain unresolved.
